name: bio-research-forge
description: Evidence-first life-science research with public bio APIs, local RNA figures, selective molecular tools, writing, and independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Life-science analysis, writing, figures, and review.
interface.longDescription: A public-data-only life-science research suite with evidence gates, secure local/HPC compute routing, omics and quantitative workflows, manuscript argument design, inline figure previews, reproducibility checks, and independent scientific review.
defaultPrompt: Audit whether my data can answer this biological question.
Create an RNA-seq figure and preview the PNG directly here.
Render this structure with PyMOL or open this sequence file in SnapGene.
Review my manuscript, figures, citations, and numeric traceability.
Query public databases and separate evidence from hypotheses.
